Chat completion via Azure OpenAI with the azure/ prefix for provider routing — verifies the prefix is stripped before dispatching and the response is normalised to the standard OpenAI chat completion shape

```elixir title="Elixir"
api_key = System.fetch_env!("API_KEY")
{:ok, client} = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = LiterLlm.defaultclient_chat_async(client, "{\"max_tokens\":16,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"azure/gpt-4\",\"temperature\":0}")
IO.inspect(result)
```
